dialogues.speaker: Santallier
dialogues.text: Actually... I've mentioned this to the higher-ups, that this area doesn't need to be patrolled.

dialogues.speaker: Santallier
dialogues.text: I mean, this is the safest block in the area, and the Champion Duelists have their office right over there.

dialogues.speaker: Santallier
dialogues.text: I didn't expect them to say "only you can take up the grand task of patrolling this area."

dialogues.speaker: Santallier
dialogues.text: Well... I've heard everyone say that you're a brilliant adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Santallier
dialogues.text: Guess we're pretty similar in how people have pinned their hopes on us, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Santallier
dialogues.text: Wanna go get a drink after work — y'know, from one person with a similar fate to another?

dialogues.speaker: Ophelia
dialogues.text: No, I'm afraid adventurers are never "off work."
